points.point: The Vault's automotive radar anchor product is the R&S AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator, used for dynamic artificial object generation (echo generation toward the radar under test).
points.label: covered
points.why: states AREG800A generates dynamic artificial radar objects/echoes

points.point: An oscilloscope is connected to the AREG800A's auxiliary receive-signal IF output at the base unit for optional signal analysis (alternative to a spectrum analyzer).
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions analog IF output and IF/baseband inspection, but not clearly AUX receive-signal IF output at base unit or optional alternative to spectrum analyzer

points.point: This auxiliary IF output path requires the R&S AREG8-K740 option (Analog IF output interfaces).
points.label: missing
points.why: does not name required AREG8-K740 option

points.point: The documented purpose of the AUX IF output port is radar signal analysis and EIRP measurements.
points.label: partial
points.why: implies IF signal/debug analysis, but omits documented EIRP-measurement purpose

points.point: Level/gain limits at the tap point: the AUX IF output measurement port is max. 0 dBm with 0 dB (nom.) gain from RX IF input to AUX IF output at the base unit.
points.label: missing
points.why: no max 0 dBm or 0 dB nominal gain limits

points.point: The scope only has to cover the IF band, whose range depends on frontend/option (e.g. 0.7 GHz to 4.7 GHz with AREG8-K740 at the 77/79 GHz frontends).
points.label: missing
points.why: does not give AUX IF frequency range or state scope only needs IF-band coverage

points.point: Power and EIRP measurement at the frontend RX power connector is a separate path that uses a power sensor, not an oscilloscope.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not distinguish frontend RX power connector power-sensor path

points.point: Other workflow-level interfaces documented for the AREG800A include a dedicated hardware-in-the-loop control interface (AREG8-K109).
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention dedicated HiL control interface AREG8-K109

invented: oscilloscope is best placed as a debug/validation instrument around the radar ECU or radar module electronics
Use the oscilloscope for interface tests and power-distribution checks
